fact: Thuas' Screamaze is a point-and-click escape-room game set in the THUAS school building late in the evening.
You came back to THUAS in the evening only to get the laptop you left in class.
The doors lock at ten and will not open again until the building lets you go.
Collect one stone from each of five rooms, put all five into the golden chest in the teachers' lounge, then give the necklace from the chest to the receptionist.
The receptionist at the front desk tells you about the five stones and the golden chest and asks for your name for the visitor log.
At the front desk you type your name, toggle the button between Male and Female, and click Start Run. The run only starts if you entered a name.
During the intro story, a click skips to the next part.
After you give the necklace, you wake up in your bed wondering if it was real, then see the leaderboard and can go back to the main menu.
The corridor is the hub: every door is clickable and leads to a room.
The five stone rooms are LAB 2.003 (ghost), Classroom 2.015 (vampire), Storage, Equinox Student Society and Project Room 3. The chest is behind Teachers Room 4.
The ghost teacher is behind the LAB 2.003 door.
The vampire is behind the Classroom 2.015 door.
The Storage door leads to the storage room with the spare fuse and the quiz.
The hungry student is behind the Equinox Student Society door.
Group 7's project room is behind the Project Room 3 door.
The teachers' lounge with the golden chest is behind the Teachers Room 4 door.
The Front Desk Office is a door in the corridor, and that's where you give the necklace at the end.
The other doors (LAB 2.001, Classroom 2.021, 2.031 and 2.035, Teachers Room 1 to 3, Project Room 1 and 2 and the Stair Exit) are side rooms to explore.
In side rooms you click an object for a close-up. Clicking the close-up again makes something creepy change, and Back takes you back.
The only item you can pick up in the side rooms is the Square badge in the beanbag in Project Room 1.
The ghost teacher has waited 347 years for his homework and won't let you leave until you hand it in.
Click the ghost teacher behind his desk to talk to him.
The homework is in the tall cabinet marked HOMEWORK in the corner of the ghost room, locked with a keypad.
The keypad code is 4537.
The code 4537 is written in the corner of the whiteboard in the ghost room.
The keypad has 0 to 9, C to clear and E to enter. After four digits the code is checked, and a wrong code just lets you try again.
Take the homework from the open cabinet, click the ghost teacher and press Give.
After you hand in the homework, the ghost teacher turns into the white stone, which lies on his empty desk for you to pick up.
The vampire is the biology teacher, and his shutters have kept the sun out for centuries.
Click the vampire to talk. After a few lines he threatens you if you keep annoying him.
The vampire says the shutters can only be opened with power to the old panel, which is the fuse box.
The fuse box in the vampire room is missing the last of its three fuses.
The spare fuse is in a box of fuses on the shelf in Storage.
Open the fuse box door in the vampire room and click Insert Fuse while carrying the fuse.
With all three fuses in, press the red button in the fuse box. The panel hums back to life and something screams outside.
After you press the red button, the red stone appears in the vampire room for you to pick up.
The Circle badge is in the drawer of the cabinet in the vampire room.
Storage has a shelf with a box of fuses and a desk with a quiz and a locked drawer.
The quiz on the Storage desk has three questions, and a wrong answer sends you back to question 1.
Quiz question 1, who is the teacher that taught biology: the answer is Vampire teacher.
Quiz question 2, how many years the ghost teacher waited for the homework: the answer is 347 years.
Quiz question 3, how many ingredients are in the sandwich: the answer is 7.
Solving the quiz unlocks the desk drawer in Storage, and the green stone is inside.
In the Equinox room a hungry student at the long table wants you to make him a sandwich.
Click the student to talk. He tells you the sandwich order, and you can click him again to hear it again.
The sandwich order is Bread, Butter, Cheese, Tomato, Lettuce, Mayo, Ham, Bread.
All ingredients lie around the Equinox room. Click one to take it, then use to the plate to put it on the plate.
The student forgives two mistakes, and the screen shows Mistakes left.
On the third mistake the lights die, you get dragged out, and the sandwich starts over.
After eating the sandwich, the student turns into a demon who has eaten in that room for 400 years, and then he vanishes.
When the demon is gone, the yellow stone lies on the long table.
The Triangle badge lies next to the yellow stone on the long table after the sandwich.
Project Room 3 is group 7's student project room with beanbags, a bookshelf, a whiteboard and a locked box.
Group 7 are Mina (designer), Jorn (builder) and Sam (presenter), and their project is THE ECHO ENGINE.
A phone between the beanbags has voicemails from Mina saying someone scattered their badges around the building and the box won't open without them.
The whiteboard quotes hint at the badges: Mina goes round and round, Jorn wants a square deal, and Sam says get to the point.
The box has three slots labelled Mina, Jorn and Sam. Pick up a badge, then click its owner's slot.
Circle belongs to Mina, Square to Jorn and Triangle to Sam.
With all three badges in, the box opens and the purple stone is inside.
The three badges are in other rooms: Circle in the vampire room, Square in Project Room 1 and Triangle in the Equinox room.
The Square badge falls out of the beanbag in Project Room 1 when you click its close-up.
The teachers' lounge is dark with burned-down candles, and the golden chest glows on a red rug on the right.
The chest lid has five holes, one for each stone colour, and you click a hole to put its stone in.
A counter on the chest shows how many of the 5 stones are in, and the lid won't budge until all five are.
If you click a hole without the matching stone, you have no stone that fits yet.
When all five stones are in, the chest opens and holds a silver necklace with a dark stone pendant.
Take the necklace to the Front Desk Office and click the receptionist behind the desk to end the game.
There are five stones: White from the ghost, Red from the vampire, Green from Storage, Purple from the project room and Yellow from the Equinox room.
Looking out a side-room window shows only darkness and your reflection, until something creepy appears in the close-up.
Classroom 2.021 has an old fridge with a handprint on the door, and opening it is something you should not have done.
At the Stair Exit the stairs go down further than the building should allow, and the fire door is chained from the other side.
Teachers Room 1 has a steel safe that opens in the close-up and holds a humming stone.
In Teachers Room 3 a radio hisses, and someone counts down under the static.
Project Room 2 has a small robot prototype with dark-crusted wheels that turns to look at you.
The vending machine in Project Room 2 drops a can even though you didn't pay.
The printer in the Front Desk Office prints a photo of the corridor with you in it.
The 3D printer in Project Room 1 prints a skull.
The Front Desk Office wall clock has stopped but still ticks, and in the close-up it shows midnight.
LAB 2.001 is a side room with computers, a humming server rack, a metal cabinet, a whiteboard and a window.
You play with the mouse: click buttons, doors and objects, and clickable things are highlighted when you hover over them.
To type, click the chat first, then type and press Enter.
Scroll the mouse wheel over the chat on the left to see older messages.
Press Esc or the pause button to open the pause menu.
The pause menu has music and sound-effect volume sliders, save game, language and resume.
Save in the pause menu with save game.
Load Game on the start screen continues in the room where you saved.
Volume settings are saved every time you move a slider.
Use the music and sound-effect sliders in the pause menu to change the volume.
Random creepy sounds like creaks, knocks, screams and footsteps play now and then, and setting the sound-effect slider to 0 turns them off.
The game is in English and Dutch, and you switch the language in the pause menu.
The Settings button on the start screen does nothing yet.
The start screen has New Game, Load Game, Settings and Leaderboard.
The Inventory button shows your items in two sections, Items and Stones.
The timer at the top only runs while the game is not paused.
The leaderboard shows the top 5 runs, ranked by completion percent first and then by fastest time.
Completion percent counts every step you've done, including inspecting side-room objects.
You can resize the window, and the game renders at 1480x720 and scales it while keeping the aspect ratio.
